_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Du späölt Golf (Kaartspel) - Speler {player_id}.
Doel: Krieg de lieëgste totaalsjore in deze enkel runde. Wenn kolomme dezelfde waerde deile, waere ze gesommeerd es 0.
Kaartwaardes: A=1, 2-10=waerde, J/Q=10, K=0

Acties (gebruuk eksakte hake):
- '[draw]' - Troke van 't deck
- '[take]' - Numme van aafgoejhövel
- '[swap X Y]' - Wissel getrokke kaart mit posisie X (riege) Y (kolom)
- '[discard]' - Gooj de getrokke kaart aaf

board.drew:
Du hees getrokke: {card}
Nu mus du [swap X Y] of [discard]
board.took:
Du hees genoomen: {card} van aafgoejhövel
Du mus [swap X Y] mit (kan 't neet aafgoeje)

options.final_turns: Letste beurte! Din opties: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Je moet: [swap X Y] (kanne kaarten van de stapel neet weggooien)

action_desc.swapped: Speler {pid} heet {new} omgeruild mit {old} op posisie ({row},{col})

message.deck_empty: 't Deck is leeg, de partij kump aaf.
message.knocked: Speler {pid} geklopt! Iedere andere speler krijgt nog 1 beurt.
message.final_round: Speler {pid} {reason}! Edere angere speler krieg eine extra beurt

invalid.wrong_action: Gebruuk eksak ein gehaokde actie: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], of [peek X Y]
invalid.must_draw_first: Du mus iers [draw], [take], [knock], of [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: 'n Kaart die oet de kaartstapel is gehaold, mós neet weggezat weure.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Du hes 'n getrokke kaart. Du mus [swap X Y] of [discard]
invalid.out_of_bounds: Posisie boete de grenze. Gebruuk riege 1-{max_row}, kolom 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Geer kint neet kloppe mèt 'n getrokke kaart. Gans e deil vaan uch beurt is d'r veur.
invalid.already_knocked: Iemand heeft deze ronde al geslagen.
